$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (mapping-message-schema-validation). Declares `message_schema`: the schema a message must match, stored once and referenced by uuid from an endpoint or a synchronization, so a partner's new version is one edit (design D1). `kind` picks the checker in lib/Service/MessageValidationService.php; a `register-schema` kind carries no document and references a register schema instead. MessageSchemaDocumentListener refuses a save whose document does not parse for its kind. Admin-only on every verb: which schema a partner's message must match is integration trust config. Seeds two examples that describe the same person, one as JSON Schema and one as XSD; no seeded endpoint or synchronization references them, so nothing changes behaviour on upgrade. Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json. It also merges a `validation` object onto `endpoint` (mode, request and response message schema, design 'Where it fits') and a `validation` list onto `call_log`, where record mode writes what it let through.

message_schema.title: Message schema
message_schema.summary: The schema a message must match
message_schema.description: A JSON Schema, an XSD or an OpenAPI description that an endpoint or a synchronization checks its messages against. See openspec/changes/mapping-message-schema-validation/specs/message-schema-validation/spec.md#requirement-a-message-schema-is-stored-once-and-referenced-req-msv-001.

name.title: Name
name.description: How you recognise this schema, for example the partner and the message

description.title: Description
description.description: What the schema is for and where it came from

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Pick json-schema, xsd or openapi to paste a document. Pick register-schema to check against a register schema

document.title: Document
document.description: Paste the schema: JSON Schema as JSON, an XSD as XML, OpenAPI as JSON or YAML. A broken document is not saved

registerSchema.title: Register schema
registerSchema.description: For kind register-schema: the register and schema slug, as register/schema

version.title: Version
version.description: The partner's version of this schema. Change it when the partner publishes a new one

validation.title: Message validation
validation.description: Check the request and the proxied answer against a message schema. Record writes the errors to the call log. Refuse answers 400 or 502

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Record lets the message through and logs the errors. Refuse stops it

messageSchema.title: Message schema
messageSchema.description: The uuid of the message schema the message must match

operationId.title: Operation
operationId.description: For an OpenAPI message schema: the operation to check against. Empty means the request's method and path

request.title: Request schema
request.description: The schema the request body must match

messageSchema.title: Message schema
messageSchema.description: The uuid of the message schema the message must match

operationId.title: Operation
operationId.description: For an OpenAPI message schema: the operation to check against. Empty means the request's method and path

response.title: Answer schema
response.description: The schema the source's answer must match

validation.title: Validation findings
validation.description: What did not match a message schema while this call was let through in record mode

objects.name: Example person (JSON Schema)
objects.description: An example to copy from: a person with a bsn, a family name and an optional date of birth. Nothing references it until you pick it on an endpoint or a synchronization.

objects.name: Example person (XSD)
objects.description: The same person as the JSON Schema example, as an XSD for XML messages. Nothing references it until you pick it on an endpoint or a synchronization.
objects.document:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" targetNamespace="https://integriq.conduction.nl/example/person" xmlns="https://integriq.conduction.nl/example/person" elementFormDefault="qualified">
  <xs:element name="persoon">
    <xs:complexType>
      <xs:sequence>
        <xs:element name="bsn">
          <xs:simpleType>
            <xs:restriction base="xs:string">
              <xs:pattern value="[0-9]{9}"/>
            </xs:restriction>
          </xs:simpleType>
        </xs:element>
        <xs:element name="geslachtsnaam" type="xs:string"/>
        <xs:element name="geboortedatum" type="xs:date" minOccurs="0"/>
      </xs:sequence>
    </xs:complexType>
  </xs:element>
</xs:schema>
